name: Pricing claim lands as one serif line
looks: A single long serif line fades in across the frame, three short claims in a row, each separated by a period, one claim's price picked out in the accent colour.
build: A single-line list-stack-reveal variant: each clause fades/slides in left to right instead of top to bottom, the accent clause getting its own colour tween; no card or UI behind it, just type on a plain field.
sound: A soft tick per clause landing, left to right.
prompt: Close on the commercial terms as one calm, confident serif line: a short run of plain claims separated by periods, landing left to right, with the price itself picked out in the brand's accent colour as the one number that matters.
